Lithium comes from Spodumene, a pale green ore found everywhere underground (Y -48 to 48) and in bigger pegmatite veins up to Y 160 under mountains and badlands.
# Lithium Brine
- Crush Spodumene into Spodumene Dust (2 per ore, 4 in the Arc Crushing Array).
- Spodumene Dust + 250 mB Sulfuric Acid in the Chemical Reactor gives 250 mB Lithium Brine.
- A Thermal Evaporator Array drying Brine into Salt also leaves 25 mB Lithium Brine per Salt, out of a Lithium Brine port.
# Lithium Hydroxide
250 mB Lithium Brine + 100 mB Lye in the Chemical Reactor gives 1 Lithium Hydroxide and 100 mB Brine back.

# Battery parts
- LFP Cathode: Lithium Hydroxide + iron dust + Basic Slag (its phosphate) in the Chemical Reactor, one in each item slot.
- Graphite: Coal Coke, or 2 Carbon Dust, baked at 1,500°C in the Arcforge Furnace. A Graphite Anode is Graphite pressed in the Metal Press with the Plate Die.
- Cell Separator: 2 Plastic Sheets make 2.
With Steel Plates and a tier alloy they make Lithium Cells and Power Regulators for the Battery Array; each tier upgrades into the next at a crafting table, keeping its charge.
